correctness.rationale: For finite k-committees with candidate qualities h_c in [q,1], reciprocal affordability sum_{c in X}1/h_c<=k implies t=|X|<=k and B=h(X)>=max(qt,t²/k) by the floor and Cauchy–Schwarz. After factoring common optimal and affordable members, quality-greedy completion of X has ratio >=1-z+max(qz,z²), z=t/k. Direct piecewise minimization gives inf 3/4 for q<=1/2 and 1-q+q² for q>=1/2. In matching party-list instances with n=rk<k voters, n-1 private voters force quality-r singleton candidates by reciprocal JR while a remaining voter supports k quality-one public candidates; optimum constrained retention tends to 1-r+r². Rational r approximates irrational q, and q=1 is equality. The proof imports from Boehmer et al. the nontrivial axiom-satisfying greedy completion existence for reciprocal EJR, threshold-PJR+ and value-EJR, which was not independently re-proved; the analytical envelope and rational witnesses were independently checked across a rational grid. This conditional reliance is stated, not disguised as a self-contained proof.
